subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should legacy ownerless session rows become permanently operator-only for plugin-runtime callers, or must an explicit migration establish ownership before strict runtime enforcement?
rationale: The cross-plugin fence is required, but runtime cannot safely infer legacy ownership and fail-closed enforcement changes existing persisted-session behavior after upgrade.

options.title: Migrate before enforcement
options.body: Add an explicit doctor or owner-controlled migration for legacy ownerless rows, then enforce strict owner matching in runtime.

options.title: Accept operator-only legacy rows
options.body: Approve ownerless rows becoming inaccessible to plugin-runtime patches and require upgrade proof and release-facing context.

recommendation.title: Migrate before enforcement
recommendation.body: Add an explicit doctor or owner-controlled migration for legacy ownerless rows, then enforce strict owner matching in runtime.

likelyOwner.reason: The accessor, projection, and storage-migration history make Josh the strongest available owner for the persisted-state policy choice.
